research_update.subtitle: 2026-07-30 · fixed-85 cluster-sector selector gate
research_update.headline: Cluster-sector removed duplicate slots and passed four clean competence windows.
research_update.summary: The same-shape selector clusters adjacent LiDAR surfaces and reserves one nearest cluster per angular sector. At 85 bars, duplicate slots fell from 1.9 to about 0.1 and unique associated bars rose from 3.0–3.5 to about 4.4. Four independent 16,384-episode windows reached 0.742, 0.745, 0.722, and 0.714 capture. The process later ended without a terminal error record at epoch 10157; checkpoint 10150 is preserved. Coverage remains close to the 4.5/8 gate, so the next evidence should come from held-out evaluation.

research_update.decision: Do not restart merely to fill the remaining epochs: four large clean windows already establish the training-side competence result. Evaluate checkpoint 10150 on the fixed density × target-speed grid. If held-out performance confirms it, freeze the navigation backbone and return to Phase 3B learned detection. The lowest-cost perception additions are occlusion/dropout evaluation and Kalman innovation reliability; CPA risk remains diagnostic-first.
